how_to_apply: Appear for the walk-in selection on 10.11.2026; reporting time 09.00 am, selection at 10.30 am.
Venue: Achutha Menon Centre for Health Science Studies of the Institute at Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram.
Bring original and copies of certificates to prove age, qualification, caste etc.
important_instructions: Vacancies include backlog: SC 3 backlog of 4, OBC 1 backlog of 2; a panel will also be formed

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. P&A.VI/28/GAT(ECG)/SCTIMST/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download SCTIMST notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Sc. in Cardiovascular Technology; B.Sc. in Echocardiography; B.Sc. in Nursing; Post graduate diploma in Cardiovascular Technology; Post-basic diploma in Cardiothoracic Nursing; Any Government approved ECG certification course completed after graduation Experience: Candidates having more than one year training or job experience after the attainment of the qualification are not eligible Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 1 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates having more than one year training or job experience after the attainment of the qualification

content_sections.heading: How Will SCTIMST Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test (may be conducted depending upon the number of candidates, to shortlist for interview) Walk-in interview A written test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for interview, depending upon the number of candidates

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original and copies of certificates to prove age Valid Caste Certificate (SC candidates) Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (OBC candidates) Income and assets certificate (EWS candidates) Category certificates issued by a Revenue Officer not below the rank of a Tahsildhar

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear for the walk-in selection on 10.11.2026; reporting time 09.00 am, selection at 10.30 am. Venue: Achutha Menon Centre for Health Science Studies of the Institute at Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram. Bring original and copies of certificates to prove age, qualification, caste etc.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Vacancies include backlog: SC 3 backlog of 4, OBC 1 backlog of 2; a panel will also be formed

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies for Graduate Apprentice in Cardiovascular Technology.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 10 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Achutha Menon Centre for Health Science Studies, Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 1 November 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stipend Rs. 12,300 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. in Cardiovascular Technology OR B.Sc. in Echocardiography OR B.Sc. in Nursing OR Post graduate diploma in Cardiovascular Technology OR Post-basic diploma in Cardiothoracic Nursing OR Any Government approved ECG certification course completed after graduation.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates having more than one year training or job experience after the attainment of the qualification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test (may be conducted depending upon the number of candidates, to shortlist for interview). Walk-in interview. A written test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for interview, depending upon the number of candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of training: 1 year.
